concepts.def: A short speech selling your idea
An opening line that grabs attention
The people listening to your pitch
Someone who puts money into a business
A share of the business you swap for cash

walkthroughs.body_html:
Your hook is the first line.

Bad: 'Hi I'd like to talk about my idea…'

Good: 'One in three school bags break. We fix that for £10.'

Start with the problem and the fix. 🎯

A great pitch tells a story:

  • The problem.
  • Your solution.
  • Who the customer is.
  • How you'll make money.
  • What you need (£ or help).

Keep it under 2 minutes.

On Dragons' Den, founders ask for cash in exchange for equity — a share of the business.

'£20,000 for 20%' means the business is valued at £100,000.

Practise your elevator pitch — 30 seconds that nails it. ⏱️
